item.title: Unsure of what to do for an R project
item.description:
Hi everyone, I have been trying my best on a piece of work for the past month and a half and I have requested university extensions however I am struggling so much with my work. I don’t know if I am doing the work right. I need to do an assignment on regression and one on mediation. I hope that I am not messaged by scammers :( I am really depressed by this work hope someone can guide me.
I have written some of the code but I am especially stuck on the data cleaning and missingness. Whether or not to impute. In an example the teacher provided they put a histogram to analyse missingness of extreme values however when I put it in R the graphs are all not visible and the scale does not adjust. I feel so exhausted today I did not sleep at all night and I don’t seem to have the confidence to do this work with the extended deadline creeping up again.
If anyone can help me review my code or anything I would so greatly appreciate it. It’s been very mentally challenging that all my classmates have submitted their work except me.
Perhaps I could DM you my task I need guidance of course not to cheat and I would appreciate anyone’s support on this.
Thank you so much for reading my message!
